overseasPhotographer.title: Overseas Location Guidelines
overseasPhotographer.line2: Phosnap is here to support you fully. However, to capture your clients' most beautiful moments, we strongly recommend visiting the location 1-2 days before shooting. Understanding the light direction, crowd levels, and movement routes will help you create much more beautiful shots.
overseasPhotographer.line3: Since you're promising important moments to your clients, no-shows without notice may result in penalties.
overseasPhotographer.line4: Stay professional to the end — treat your clients with good manners and a positive attitude. Your professionalism represents all of Phosnap.
overseasPhotographer.confirm: Confirmed. I will add overseas locations.

overseasHmk.title: Overseas Hair & Makeup Guidelines
overseasHmk.line1: Have you fully discussed the makeup location with your clients? 💄
overseasHmk.line2: When working in a hotel room instead of a dedicated makeup studio, we recommend advising clients to book accommodations close to the shoot location (within 30 minutes). Long travel times can cause makeup to smudge.
overseasHmk.line3: Phosnap prioritizes your safety. If you foresee any dangerous or uncomfortable situations, please contact Phosnap immediately without hesitation. We'll work through it together.
overseasHmk.line4: Since you're promising important moments to your clients, no-shows without notice may result in penalties.
overseasHmk.line5: Stay professional to the end — treat your clients with good manners and a positive attitude.
overseasHmk.confirm: Confirmed. I will add overseas locations.
